column1: # English abbreviation lexicon for DemaConsulting.Speech.Text.En (embedded resource).
# Written from scratch by DEMA Consulting and released under the MIT license of this package.
# No third-party abbreviation list was copied; the rows are common written-English
# Format: UTF-8, LF, tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# The first remaining line is the header. Columns:
#   form     the token exactly as written, case-sensitive (a trailing '.' is part of the form)
#   spoken   the words spoken instead (for class 'word' the written word itself; no replacement)
#   class    prefix = precedes a name; suffix = follows a name or street; free = either;
#            word = the ordinary word followed by a real period
#   default  yes on exactly one row per form: the reading used when the context is inconclusive
#   guard    '-' for none, or '+'-joined conditions: next-cap, next-digit, prev-not-number,
#            next-date (next token starts with an ASCII digit or is a month name or abbreviation),
#            prev-number (previous token starts with an ASCII digit)
# Several rows with the same form are alternative readings (see the design documentation).
